findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "check_vendor_trust" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Get Disclosed Labs' trust verdict for a specific peptide vendor/source: our 0-100 trust score, A-F grade, COA count, avg purity, safety-panel coverage, lab corr…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: compare_peptide_prices · Public sink: compare_peptide_prices.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: compare_peptide_prices · Public sink: compare_peptide_prices

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
